contents.Text: The directory where downloaded songs will be saved.
By default, this is usually the same directory selected in the searcher.
The number of downloads that can occur simultaneously.
[[[warning:Note:]]] It is best to use a smaller number, even [[[strong:1]]], if you have time. Higher numbers increase the likelihood of a download failing.
This is because more requests are sent to websites each second. If too many requests are made, the server may temporarily reject them before accepting requests again.
These are the same as the fields in [[[button:Key and below in Playlist Editor][../Playlist Editor]]]
[[[strong:Spotfetch_download_selection:]]] This selects what you want to download from spotify:
[[[strikethrough:Import/Export]]] does not exist anymore this in the future will be its own standalone feature
